Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Computer Vision [IT_4408]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Discuss the image types. Explain how these image types differ in terms of the amount of               (5)  
  information they contain and their typical applications in real-world scenarios.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Analyze the roles of pixels, color channels, feature extraction, and pattern recognition in Computer (5)  
  Vision using a suitable real-world scenario of your choice. Illustrate your explanation with diagrams.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Discuss how the Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) descriptor represents object shape and          (5)  
  structure. Describe the major computation steps and discuss why it performs well in pedestrian  
  A)           detection tasks..  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Apply the histogram equalization and also find the negative to the 4*4 matrix of your choice.         (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Apply calibration techniques to align multiple cameras on a robotic arm for precise 3D object         (5)  
  localization.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyze the knowledge of geometric transformations to stabilize video frames recorded from a          (5)  
  moving vehicle by compensating for camera motion.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Analyse the Lucas-Kanade method to estimate the motion of a surgical instrument in consecutive        (5)  
  endoscopic frames. Describe how you would select window size, pyramidal levels, and error  
  A)           thresholds to maintain accurate tracking despite specular highlights  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Apply an optical-flow based motion compensation before background subtraction in a traffic camera (5)  
  to improve vehicle detection during camera vibrations. Explain parameter choices and evaluation  
  criteria  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        Analyze a face detection system for a classroom attendance application that automatically marks     (5)  
  students as present based on camera input. Discuss challenges like lighting, occlusion, and pose  
  A)                variation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Apply a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to detect cracks and corrosion in metal structures       (5)  
  from drone inspection images. Describe how data augmentation helps improve generalization  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
